nota: Fase 16 — peças de salão que a 15 não tem: lareira central do mégaron, tear de Penélope, escudos dos pretendentes no chão, facho de luz da aurora.

args.description: the great round central hearth of a Mycenaean megaron hall, a low raised ring of painted stone with a bed of glowing embers and a small steady fire, thin smoke rising, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the hearth and its fire. Palette of warm limestone and dark wood lit by orange firelight, with cool night-blue shadows. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
